title: Complete lattices and monotone fixed points
proposed_reference_coverage: **Complete lattices and monotone fixed points: Knaster–Tarski**
fact_or_context_to_reference: The fixed points of a monotone map on a complete lattice form a complete lattice in their induced order. The least and greatest fixed points are respectively the infimum of pre-fixed points and supremum of post-fixed points; internal fixed-point bounds need not equal ambient meets and joins. Include the power-set fixed-point proof of Cantor–Schroeder–Bernstein.
